title: Deliciu V2 Kiwi Passion Fruit Guava 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid by Vaporesso
description: Deliciu V2 Kiwi Passion Fruit Guava Nic Salt brings a tantalising tropical experience with a vibrant trio of flavours. The sweet and tangy notes of kiwi meld perfectly with the exotic taste of passion fruit, while the smooth guava rounds off this blend with a refreshing tropical sweetness. This rich and fruity vape offers a balanced flavour profile that will appeal to vapers who love tropical fruit flavours. Formulated with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Deliciu V2 Nic Salts are ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape kits and pod devices. The enhanced formulation ensures smoothness and rich flavour with every puff. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, these nicotine salts provide rapid nicotine relief and a smoother throat hit compared to traditional freebase e-liquids. The Deliciu V2 range from Vaporesso revamps the original line up of bestselling flavours with a heightened focus on quality and flavour precision, delivering improved profiles based on customer feedback. Designed for compatibility with a wide range of low-powered MTL devices, Deliciu V2 Nic Salts deliver exceptionally authentic flavours and consistent, enjoyable vaping.
